categories.main_business_segments: Global Payments operates through three primary business segments: Merchant Solutions, Issuer Solutions, and Consumer Solutions. Merchant Solutions provides payment technology and software solutions to merchants globally. Issuer Solutions offers card processing and related services to financial institutions and corporations. Consumer Solutions, which is being divested, delivers prepaid debit and payroll cards and other financial services to underbanked consumers and businesses in the U.S.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages a multi-channel, global technology infrastructure, including cloud-based enterprise software, integrated payment gateways, and SaaS platforms. Its solutions encompass payment authorization, settlement, funding, analytics, human capital management, and vertical-specific software for industries such as healthcare, education, hospitality, and property management. Security, compliance, and scalability are emphasized through advanced cybersecurity, data protection, and proprietary technology.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Global Payments serves approximately 4 million merchant locations and over 1,500 financial institutions worldwide. Its key customers include merchants of all sizes, financial institutions, software partners, technology providers, and, through its Consumer Solutions segment, underbanked consumers and businesses. Major end markets include retail, healthcare, education, hospitality, property management, and government.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates in over 170 countries, with significant presence in North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and Latin America. The United States accounts for about 80% of total revenues, with additional operations and customers in Canada, the UK, Spain, and other international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Global Payments primarily operates downstream in the payments value chain, acting as a payment processor, merchant acquirer, and technology solutions provider. It also serves as an issuer processor for financial institutions and manages prepaid card programs, positioning itself close to end users and businesses.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include leading with technology and innovation, expanding software-driven and omnichannel solutions, increasing exposure to high-growth markets, and scaling B2B payments. The company invests in cloud modernization, new product development, and integration of acquired businesses, with a focus on digital payments, ecommerce, and emerging technologies. Divestitures and acquisitions are used to align with core corporate customers and enhance scale and capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through transaction-based fees (percentage of transaction value or per-transaction fees), software subscription and licensing fees, and value-added services. Issuer Solutions revenues are derived from long-term processing contracts, while Consumer Solutions earns fees from cardholder activity and subscriptions. Additional revenue streams include equipment sales, professional services, and partnership arrangements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include Fiserv, FIS, Chase Paymentech, Elavon, Bank of America Merchant Services, Wells Fargo Merchant Services, Toast, Stripe, Shopify, Block (Square), Worldline, Nexi, Adyen, Marqeta, Green Dot, InComm, and Chime. Global Payments is positioned as a leading, technology-driven payments provider with a broad global footprint and strong vertical market focus, competing on innovation, scale, and integrated solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended December 31, 2022, Global Payments reported consolidated revenues of $8.98 billion, up 5.3% from the prior year. The company is a Fortune 500 and S&P 500 constituent, with approximately 25,000 employees. Growth is driven by increased digital payment adoption, acquisitions, and expansion into new markets, though 2022 results were impacted by goodwill impairment and divestitures.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Global Payments differentiates itself through innovative, secure, and scalable technology solutions, a global footprint, and deep expertise in vertical markets. Its value proposition centers on enabling efficient, omnichannel commerce, providing integrated software and payment solutions, and delivering high-quality, responsive customer service. The company emphasizes its ability to support complex, multinational operations and its strong partner ecosystem.
